body.name: signed-shift and split-reference boundary witnesses
body.construction: For \(d=3\), \(r=2\), and \(E=2\), set \(B_{\mu}=0\), \(C_{\mu}=0\), \(\omega_{0,\mu}=(3/2,3/2,3/2)^{\mathsf T}\), \(\Omega_{\eta,\mu}=I_3/2\), and \(T_{\mu}=\{1,2\}\).  Define \(\theta^{\pm}\) by \(\lambda_1=(1,1,0)^{\mathsf T}\) and \(\lambda_2=(-1/2,0,0)^{\mathsf T}\), so \(\Sigma_0=2I_3\), \(\Sigma_1=\operatorname{diag}(3,3,2)\), and \(\Sigma_2=\operatorname{diag}(3/2,2,2)\).  Define \(\theta^{\mathrm{split}}\) by \(\lambda_1=(1,0,0)^{\mathsf T}\) and \(\lambda_2=(0,1,0)^{\mathsf T}\), so \(\Sigma_0=2I_3\), \(\Sigma_1=\operatorname{diag}(3,2,2)\), and \(\Sigma_2=\operatorname{diag}(2,3,2)\).
